description: In every PA-model, entry at a successor index in a constructed list is entry at the preceding index in its tail.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listEntry_cons_successor_value.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] (a c i : M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listEntry.value
      ![Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listCons.value ![a, c],
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M i] =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listEntry.value ![c, i]
